::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [28 January 1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge VI 2[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd),
Here is a demand from the [London library](organizations/other_29.qmd) for you. I hope you have done with the book.

The weather shews that you were wise. I hope to see you as soon as it looks more mild

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper, with  envelope addressed to  'Miss Elizthe Sewell/Bonchurch/I of Wight' and postmarked Winchester and Ventnor 28 and 29 January 1870.
